overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Barley Grass Powder for B2B buyers in food, beverage, nutraceutical, and personal care manufacturing. We operate as an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter from India, with bulk supply support for IndiaMART buyers and international importers. Our focus is consistent product specifications, steady availability, and clean handling from sourcing to dispatch.

Our Barley Grass Powder is fine milled and offered in 80-100 mesh form with moisture below 5.0%. The product is processed through a 6-step flow: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. OEM and private label options are available, along with custom mesh and packaging on request. Samples and export documentation support can be arranged.
